what: Documented why all 4 GitHub Actions workflows were silently disabled and how to prevent it; fixed file-tree.md OKF type error
why: The 60-day auto-disable will recur unless a PAT-based keepalive or occasional manual commits keep the repo "active" — future sessions need this context
summary: Recorded learning: GitHub auto-disables scheduled workflows after 60 days of repo inactivity, and GITHUB_TOKEN commits (README-timestamp bot) don't count as activity — explains the 2026-08-24 disable of all 4 workflows; recurrence expected ~60d after last real commit, keepalive cron with PAT is the fix. Also fixed E3 conformance error: file-tree.md type Reference → Artifact.
